title: cyclosorus obstructus
intro: Cyclosorus obstructus, commonly known as the interrupted sword fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a perennial plant native to tropical and subtropical regions, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus obstructus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
